kb_proposals: A singular structure glued from copies of a model (here two copies of C_θ on 𝕊²): generate it from the pushed-forward charts of each copy, check the cross chart changes through the model's developing map on a cover (sphCone_chart_dev, then IsOpenMap.nhds_le to push the eventuality down), get each copy's inclusion as an a.e. morphism from GX.isAEMorphismOf_maximalAEAtlas_of_forall and its X_α-chart from GX.XAChart.ofIsOpenEmbedding (T-gx-cone-football; reusable for T-gx-troyanov-triangle's doubled triangle).

A second structure on a known space goes on a type synonym (def Football θ : Type := Sph2) with explicit identity maps toSph2/ofSph2: an ascription (y : Sph2) does not convert, and a term proof whose defeq check unfolds SphCone.homeoComplex times out at 200000 heartbeats; state the defeq once as an rfl lemma (footballEmb_mk) and rewrite with it (T-gx-cone-football).
notes: 0 sorry. `taskset -c 0-11 lake build GXScaffold.Spherical.Football`: built, only this module (8581 jobs, `--no-build` beforehand showed nothing upstream out of date). `lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true` on the file: clean, so it can graduate to GX.Spherical.Football as is (one import, GX.Spherical.ConeSurface). #print axioms on the main declarations (isConeSphere_football, football_sing_eq, football_sing_eq_empty, football_two_pi_round, football_two_pi_isAEMorphism_round, exists_isConeSphere_two, footballFlip_mem_singularAut, XAChart.ofIsOpenEmbedding, isAEMorphismOf_maximalAEAtlas_of_forall, isAEAtlas_footballAtlas, footballSingularGXStructure): [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (probe written in the campaign directory and deleted). The scaffold root is not edited: the master adds `import GXScaffold.Spherical.Football` (kb 0025). The five instances TopologicalSpace/T2Space/LocallyConnectedSpace/SecondCountableTopology/ConnectedSpace on Football θ are anonymous; the named one is GX.footballSingularGXStructure. The planner's [r] claim is checked and true: the chart at S is the apex chart after (r, φ) ↦ (1/r, −φ), i.e. v ↦ 1/v, the half-turn (t, w) ↦ (−t, w̄), det 1 (GX.halfTurn_smul_stereoInv, GX.det_flipIsom). Remark, not a new finding: the football is the two-centre reading (r ∈ [0, π], both ends collapsed) of the Thurston suspension of l.697–700 for the circle of length θ (a point at distance ρ from one apex is at distance π − ρ from the other in the developed charts), and it has two singular points for θ ≠ 2π; this corroborates the existing l.698–700 finding and OQ-37 (a) (the one-centre reading for a local model). It is built by gluing two copies of C_θ, not through GX.thurstonStructure, and no metric is formalized. The half-turn is a non-trivial automorphism (footballFlip_mem_singularAut): the football is one of the 'very particular Σ' of l.1933.
